spans.s: Coming from an insect or worm.

N. of a demon killed by Viṣṇu. [He was a very powerful
 demon. He and Madhu are said to have sprung from the ears of Viṣṇu while
 he was asleep; and when they were about to devour Brahman they were slain by Viṣṇu].

+ .{@-भा, -भी@} An epithet of Durgā.
.━{@Comp.@}: कैटभारिः, कैटभार्दनः, कैटभजित्
